title: About
text:
№ — the one behind the lens
    

    
      About
      Praveen Kumar Singh
      Photographer & Atmospheric Science Researcher
      
      Based in — Paris

      
      
        I see the world through my lens, finding stories in the streets, beauty in nature, and history in every monument. My photography is driven by curiosity and a desire to capture authentic moments, explore unique perspectives, and preserve the details that make every place special. From the quiet wilderness to the rhythm of everyday life, I aim to turn fleeting moments into lasting visual stories.
      
      
        I’m open to photography commissions, creative collaborations, and opportunities to share my work through prints. Whether you’re looking for a unique visual story, a special image for your space, or a collaboration on a creative project, I’d love to hear from you. Feel free to get in touch to discuss ideas, explore possibilities, or simply connect over a shared passion for photography.
